info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Tungst Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of detailed entries in the Tungst drill catalog. It allows users to register new drill specifications, including characteristics such as size, type, and performance metrics. Typical consumers of this API include developers integrating catalog management features into their applications, as well as operators managing inventory and product details. By leveraging this API, organizations can maintain accurate and updated catalogs that enhance product visibility and streamline inventory processes.

post.summary: Create a new detail for a Tungst drill.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to add new details related to a Tungst drill. It accepts specific details within the request body to capture relevant information necessary for the Tungst drill's operations.
